evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-14"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-14". A POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain YYYY-MM-DD string with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/3 {"dueDate":"2026-11-11"} returned 200 and changed the date. PATCH /todos/4 with a date set one, and {"dueDate":null} cleared it (200, dueDate null). PATCH {"title":...} alone left the due date unchanged.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "15.10.2026", "2026-10-15T10:00:00" and "garbage" each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" and "xx" each returned 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15 UTC. The todos were: past due 10-14 not done, due today 10-15, future due 11-11, no date, and a done todo due 2026-01-01. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the 10-14 todo. The done past-due todo, the due-today todo, the future todo and the undated todo were all excluded. ?overdue=false returned all five.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed 'fällig 2026-10-14', 'fällig 2026-10-15', 'fällig 2026-11-11' and 'fällig 2026-01-01' next to their todos. The todo without a date showed none.
evidence.AC6: Only the 'past' todo (due 10-14, not done) showed '– überfällig'. The todos due today, in the future, undated and done-with-past-date had no such word.
evidence.AC7: The page has a button labelled 'nur überfällige'. After I clicked it, the list showed only the 'past' todo, and the button label changed to 'alle anzeigen'.
